automationCorrections.explanation: Failed invitation retained unsaved recipient input. Dismissed beforeunload correctly blocked two queued navigations; no extra invitation write occurred.
Runner originally waited for dashboard heading while restoring a group page. Fixed restore readiness; one later join wait had no invitation because preceding runner action had failed.

Two false negatives: model represented date choices as ENUM labels, while the assertion expected ISO dates. Canonical authenticated owner reads confirm all five intended selections; no answer was replayed or changed.

Runner restored expired access tokens and initially reinjected stale session state after navigation. Reauthenticated, restricted restoration to valid sessions and stopped overwriting an existing session. No app authentication behavior was changed or classified as an app outage.
Runner inspected immediately after tab change before the new response arrived. Later complete read confirmed the shared history; no message was resent.

Background private-answer mask covered foreground card/outcome regions in initial screenshots. Original files retained with this limitation. Final card, mobile card and outcome were recaptured read-only with component-scoped redaction; use the final-readback images.

scopeLimits: One five-user happy path and bounded conversation/privacy checks; no statistical reliability guarantee.
Vercel full flow; Amplify root HTTP/assets only, not a second authenticated full flow.
No native Alexa+ client, new signups, email delivery, disjoint/no-solution case, withdrawal, deletion, or >12 member pagination tested in this variant.
No fresh AWS package/worker attestation or provider billing/token telemetry. Observed request counts are not billed invocation counts.
No application code, deployed settings, IAM, schedules or existing fixtures changed. Test accounts and new owned fixture remain available for review.
